overloads.semanticRole: Tests whether the current record pointer for aTable has moved past the last record of the current selection (e.g. after NEXT RECORD), or the selection is empty.

constraints: PREVIOUS RECORD does not move the pointer back into range once it is past the boundary; use FIRST RECORD, LAST RECORD, or GOTO SELECTED RECORD to do so.
Also returns True in the last footer when a report is printed via PRINT SELECTION or the Print menu, so it can be used to detect the last page's footer.
